# Cohort Overview

```{r analyze_cohorts}
# Run one of the first functions
cohort_results <- analyze_student_cohorts(
  dataset = df, 
  extra_variables = c("GENDER", "ETHNICITY", "SCHOOL_NUMBER")
)

```

```{r cohort_text}
#| results: asis

# Generate summary text
summary_text <- report_cohort_overview(cohort_results$Summary)
cat(summary_text$Detailed_Summary)

```

```{r first_table}
# Show summary table of cohort persistence
table_clean <- cohort_results$Table
table_clean[is.na(table_clean)] <- ""
knitr::kable(table_clean, caption = cohort_results$Caption)

```
